market_story: The declared capacity-emergency windows now fire in the hours MISO actually declared them: the Aug-26-2024 Max Gen Warning's first hour (13:00 EST = 12:00 CST) is scarce in the model as it was in the market (the M-2 revealed derates and the $500 Tier-1 floor apply there, $62 -> $447), and 20:00 EST — never inside the Warning — no longer carries them ($66 -> $49). The 2025 Warning/Step-1 windows still carry no slack (min idle thermal 2.18 GW): the 2025 summer tail is not an emergency-instrument object, which is why C3a-2025 is unchanged to the decimal.
